# Kwant-Atlas — Master Corpus & Acquisition List

**Purpose:** the complete set of textbooks, papers, and materials recommended to build the Kwant-Atlas from zero to near-professional across every pillar/area. Generated by 10 parallel research agents (extensive web research, bibliographies verified). Each domain has its own detailed wishlist in this `corpus/` folder; this file is the consolidated view for sourcing decisions.

**Goal of a domain corpus:** give members of *any* background (CS, math, econ, none) a route from zero to near-Wall-Street in that field — and give the Atlas-builder the authoritative sources to write each topic's math/code ground truth.

---

## Status legend (per-corpus files use their own tags; this is the consolidated meaning)
- **HAVE** — already verified/embedded in the Atlas (from the Investing-folder deep-read). Do not re-acquire.
- **SOURCE / CORE / ★ P / MUST-HAVE** — canonical, acquire first; anchors a sub-topic's math ground truth.
- **CITE / STRONG / NICE / OPTIONAL / SUP** — valuable; cite in-page and acquire for completeness as budget allows.
- **FREE / [Free]** — legal free copy exists (author/publisher-hosted, paper PDF, official doc). Grab at zero cost first.
- **Difficulty:** 🟢 intro (zero-to-running) · 🟡 intermediate · 🔴 advanced/reference

## 1. Pillar 3 — Derivative Pricing & Structuring  → `pillar3-derivative-pricing.md`
**Have (deep, verified):** Hull 11e (37ch), Shreve I+II, Björk 3e, Brigo-Mercurio 2e, Glasserman.
**Top SOURCE acquisitions (full books worth obtaining):**
- Natenberg, *Option Volatility & Pricing* (2e) — trader's bible for options conventions.
- **Gatheral, *The Volatility Surface*** — the local-vol/smile canon.
- **Bergomi, *Stochastic Volatility Modeling*** — advanced modern vol treatment.
- **Duffy, *Finite Difference Methods in Financial Engineering*** — PDE numerics.
- **Gregory, *The xVA Challenge*** — counterparty risk/xVA.
- **Haug, *The Complete Guide to Option Pricing Formulas*** — pure lookup (ideal for the Atlas lookup role).
- Wilmott, *Paul Wilmott on Quantitative Finance* — practice breadth.
- Sinclair, *Volatility Trading* / *Option Trading*.
**Key SOURCE papers:** Black-Scholes 1973 (JPE); Merton 1973 (Bell J); Cox-Ross-Rubinstein 1979; Heston 1993 (RFS); Dupire 1994; Hagan et al. 2002 (SABR, Wilmott); Carr-Madan 1999 (FFT, JCF); Longstaff-Schwartz 2001 (RFS); Gatheral-Jaisson 2014 (rough vol).

## 2. Pillar 1 — Quantitative Research & Alpha  → `pillar1-quantitative-research.md`
**Have:** Tsay 3e; ESL 2e; Hasbrouck.
**Top SOURCE acquisitions:** Vidyamurthy *Pairs Trading*; **López de Prado *Advances in Financial Machine Learning*** (also Pillar 7); Pardo *The Evaluation and Optimization of Trading Strategies* (backtest hygiene); Ang *Asset Management: A Systematic Approach to Factor Investing*; Grinold & Kahn *Active Portfolio Management*; Chan *Quantitative Trading* / *Algorithmic Trading* (accessible code-based).
**Key papers:** Gatev-Goetzmann-Rouwenhorst 2006 (pairs, RFS); Avellaneda-Lee 2010 (stat-arb); Fama-French 1993/2015; Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012 (time-series momentum); Jegadeesh-Titman 1993; Bailey & López de Prado (DSR, backtest overfitting); Asness et al.

## 3. Pillar 2 — Algorithmic & HFT  → `pillar2-algorithmic-hft.md`
**Have:** Hasbrouck; Foucault-Pagano-Roell.
**Top SOURCE acquisitions:** Cartea, Jaimungal & Penalva *Algorithmic and High-Frequency Trading* (CUP 2015) — the mathematical spine; Johnson *Algorithmic Trading & DMA* (practitioner); Narang *Inside the Black Box* (intro); Aldridge *High-Frequency Trading* (practical); Kissell *The Science of Algorithmic Trading*.
**Key papers:** Almgren-Chriss 2000 (optimal execution, J. Risk); Almgren et al. 2005; Cartea-Jaimungal (execution/market making); Bouchaud et al. (market impact); Obizhaeva-Wang 2013.
**Note (per agent):** low-latency/FPGA/clock-sync have few canonical textbooks — source official docs/specs (see `pillar2` file and Pillar 8).

## 4. Pillar 4 — Quantitative Risk  → `pillar4-quantitative-risk.md`
**Have:** Hull (VaR/credit); Glasserman (risk MC); Tsay (VaR/EVT); Foucault-Pagano-Roell (liquidity).
**Top CORE acquisitions:** **McNeil, Frey & Embrechts *Quantitative Risk Management*** (2e, the canon); Jorion *Value at Risk* (3e); **Gregory *The xVA Challenge*** (counterparty); Hull *Risk Management and Financial Institutions* (5e, regulatory glue); Dowd *Beyond Value at Risk*.
**Key papers / regs:** Artzner et al. 1999 (coherent risk measures); Basel II/III, FRTB, SA-CCR (free official); Embrechts EVT; Merton 1974 (credit).

## 5. Pillar 5 — Portfolio Optimization  → `pillar5-portfolio-optimization.md`
**Have:** ESL (regularization/PCA); Tsay (factor models); math toolbox.
**Top MUST-HAVE:** Markowitz 1952 (paper); **Grinold & Kahn *Active Portfolio Management***; Ang *Asset Management* (factor); Ledoit-Wolf (shrinkage papers); **López de Prado *Machine Learning for Asset Managers*** (HRP); Black-Litterman (papers + book); Boyd & Vandenberghe *Convex Optimization* (foundations); Clarke-de Silva-Thorley (risk parity papers); Kelly 1956 (paper).
**Key papers:** Markowitz 1952; Black-Litterman 1992; Ledoit-Wolf 2004; DeMiguel et al. 2009 (1/N); López de Prado HRP 2016; Kelly 1956.

## 6. Pillar 6 — Market Making & Liquidity  → `pillar6-market-making.md`
**Have:** Hasbrouck; Foucault-Pagano-Roell; Glosten-Milgrom/Kyle/Roll papers embedded.
**Top ★ P / CORE acquisitions:** Cartea-Jaimungal-Penalva (also P2); **Guéant *The Financial Mathematics of Market Liquidity***; Lehalle & Laruelle (eds.) *Market Microstructure in Practice*; O'Hara *Market Microstructure Theory* (classic); Harris *Trading and Exchanges* (intro).
**Key papers:** Cont-Stoikov-Talreja 2010 (LOB model, ★); Cont-Kukanov-Stoikov 2014 (OFI, ★); Avellaneda-Stoikov 2008; Guéant-Lehalle-Fernandez-Tapia 2013; Easley-López de Prado-O'Hara (VPIN); Almgren 2003 (impact); Bouchaud et al.

## 7. Pillar 7 — ML & Alternative Data  → `pillar7-machine-learning.md`
**Have:** ESL 2e; Tsay (regime); ML math via Foundations.
**Top SOURCE:** **López de Prado *Advances in Financial Machine Learning*** (2018) — THE hub; **López de Prado *Machine Learning for Asset Managers*** (2020).
**Key papers:** López de Prado (purged/embargoed CV, DSR, triple-barrier/meta-labeling); Devlin et al. 2018 (BERT → FinBERT); Gu-Kelly-Xiu 2020 (Empirical Asset Pricing via ML, RFS); Sirignano-Cont (deep learning for price); regime HMM papers.

## 8. Pillar 8 — Quantitative Development  → `pillar8-quant-dev.md`
**Have:** none dedicated (code lives inside finance books). Almost all SOURCE/CITE.
**Top SOURCE (High priority):** Ghosh *Building Low Latency Applications with C++* (2023); Meyers *Effective Modern C++*; Williams *C++ Concurrency in Action* (2e); Bryant & O'Hallaron *CS:APP*; Sutter & Alexandrescu (concurrency/lockless). Python stack: McKinney *Python for Data Analysis*, Lampton *Numba*, vectorbt docs.
**CITE/FREE (official docs/specs):** FIX protocol spec; kdb+/q reference (Kx); DuckDB/ClickHouse docs; exchange market-data specs; Linux perf/networking. High-priority for the Atlas's practical code examples.

## 9. Foundations — Mathematics Toolbox  → `foundations-mathematics.md`
**Have:** Shreve I+II; Björk; Tsay; ESL; Glasserman; thin LA note + single-var calculus.pdf (the 2 real gaps).
**FREE now (author/publisher-hosted):** Axler *Linear Algebra Done Right*; Boyd & Vandenberghe *Convex Optimization*; Durrett *Probability: Theory & Examples*; MacKay *ITILA*; MIT Mathematics for CS.
**Top purchase order:** 1 Strang *Intro to Linear Algebra* · 2 Hubbard & Hubbard *Vector Calculus* (fills thin calc note) · 3 Blitzstein & Hwang *Intro to Probability* · 4 Simon & Blume *Mathematics for Economists* (econ-background on-ramp) · 5 Billingsley *Probability & Measure* · 6 Øksendal *SDEs* · 7 Casella & Berger *Statistical Inference* · 8 Hamilton *Time Series Analysis* · 9 Boyd & Vandenberghe · 10 Nocedal & Wright *Numerical Optimization* · 11 Cover & Thomas *Information Theory* · 12 Gelman *BDA3* · 13 Trefethen & Bau *Numerical Linear Algebra* · 14 Efron & Hastie *Computer Age Statistical Inference* · 15 Graham-Knuth-Patashnik *Concrete Mathematics*.

## 10. Fundamentals & Accounting  → `fundamentals-accounting.md`
**Have:** user's own notes (already embedded). **Zero canonical coverage yet.**
**Priority (Books):** Penman *Financial Statement Analysis & Security Valuation*; Damodaran *Investment Valuation*; Graham & Dodd *Security Analysis* (6e); Graham *The Intelligent Investor*; Schilit *Financial Shenanigans* (4e); O'Glove *Quality of Earnings*; Koller et al. *Valuation* (McKinsey, 8e); Palepu & Healy *Business Analysis & Valuation*; Mulford & Comiskey *Financial Numbers Game*; Gray & Carlisle *Quantitative Value*; O'Shaughnessy *What Works on Wall Street*.
**Key [Free] papers/data:** Piotroski 2000 (F-score); Sloan 1996 (accruals); Fama-French 2015 (5-factor); Novy-Marx 2013 (gross profitability); Green-Hand-Zhang 2017; Ken French Data Library; SEC EDGAR.
